fields.description: Linked AI Provider. When set, this model's API Key and Base URL are ignored — both are read from the linked AI Provider instead. Leave blank to use this model's own API Key/Base URL directly against an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: Bare model identifier for the OpenAI-compatible transport, e.g. gemini-2.5-flash, gpt-4.1, llama3.1. No provider/ prefix — provider identity and endpoint come from the Provider above.
fields.label: Model ID

fields.description: Max input tokens. Not auto-detected (no Agno equivalent to litellm's model registry) — enter manually, or leave 0 if unknown.
fields.label: Context Window

fields.description: API key to authenticate with this model's endpoint. Only used when no Provider is linked above — a linked Provider's own API Key is used instead.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Endpoint for this model, e.g. a self-hosted Ollama (http://localhost:11434), a proxy, or another OpenAI-compatible API. Only used when no Provider is linked above — a linked Provider's own Base URL is used instead.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Optional JSON object passed to the model (e.g. {"temperature": 0.2, "max_tokens": 1024})
fields.label: Params
